declaration.source: minifilament assembly/exchange, FRAP t1/2 ~10-30 s ORDER OF MAGNITUDE. PI-GAP. READ (nmii-life lane, 2026-09-21): with nmii.disassembly_rate it is the two-state life of a whole minifilament OBJECT (physics/object_life), and the ratio ka/(ka+kd) is the stationary ASSEMBLED fraction, so the free pool the build carries as dormant objects is assembled x (kd/ka). not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED

as nmii.assembly_rate; PI-GAP. READ (nmii-life lane, 2026-09-21) as the rate at which an assembled minifilament object leaves the world, releasing every crossbridge relation it owns. Disassembly WITHOUT reassembly is not a partial implementation but a destructive one (95 % of the population gone in 100 s), so the two rows are wired as one law or not at all — physics/object_life.object_blocks refuses ka = 0 with kd > 0. not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED

active (RLC-phosphorylated) fraction — PI-GAP (a target Aleph must find; the number is an initial point). WHICH READING THE BUILD TAKES (nmii-life lane, 2026-09-21, after three rows were found to claim one quantity): this row is HEAD COMPETENCE and nothing else — cell/bonds.kinetic_owners gives a crossbridge relation to only this fraction of heads, and the built OBJECT count does not depend on it. The clause that stood here until today — the one asserting that this row fixed the assembled-minifilament fraction, quoted verbatim as the sentinel _ASSEMBLY_CLAIM in cell/nmii_molecules.py and deliberately NOT repeated in this file, so that restoring it here is what trips the refusal — is the reading the build does NOT take: nmii.areal_density (SOURCED, Nie 2015) already counts ASSEMBLED minifilaments and nmii.assembly_rate/nmii.disassembly_rate already fix the assembled fraction at ka/(ka+kd) = 0.5, so applying this row to the object count as well would reduce one population twice and would declare one fraction to be both 0.3 and 0.5. NEITHER VALUE WAS CHANGED to reconcile them — the readings were made disjoint and cell/nmii_molecules.assembled_population refuses the double count with the numbers. not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED

NMIIA:IIB ratio — MCF7 unknown; 1.0 = all IIA. PI-GAP. READ (nmii-life lane, 2026-09-21) by cell/build/nmii: the isoform is assigned PER MINIFILAMENT (co-assembly of mixed bipolar filaments is real, but no row in this file gives a mixing rule, so a per-head draw would be an invented law), deterministically in cell.seed, and the IIB minifilaments' heads own a second crossbridge kind reading the crossbridge.iib.* rows below. At 1.0 no IIB head exists, the second kind is not built, and the build is the pre-2026-09-21 one bit for bit. not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED

evidence_cards.cell_or_specimen_context: Human MCF7; adherent confluent epithelial monolayers / zonula adherens (ZA), not suspended rounded cells.
evidence_cards.observation_unit: Bulk isoform peptide share from extracted culture; junctional fluorescence is a separate observation.
evidence_cards.review_note: IIA/IIB/IIC percentages derive from peptide counts divided by total NMHC peptides after RIPA extraction, 10,000g clarification, SDS-PAGE and tryptic LC-MS/MS. Results call errors SEM; Methods says SD was calculated. Replicate count and raw peptide table were not located. Fig.1 shows IIA/IIB at ZA; that does not allocate all cellular myosin to ZA or resolve coassembly. This narrows the MCF7 abundance gap but does not identify per-minifilament isoform assignment.

evidence_cards.cell_or_specimen_context: Human MCF7, isoform overexpression or knockdown; live imaging at 37°C, 5% CO2.
evidence_cards.observation_unit: Cell/bleb trajectory, fluorescent-label proximity dwell, and AFM indentation on separate cells.
evidence_cards.review_note: GFP-heavy-chain/LifeAct-RFP high-FRET dwell is a label-proximity readout; it is not isolated head detachment or whole-object death. Movies join fluorescence and bleb morphology within a cell. AFM uses protrusion-free membrane regions, a pyramidal probe (nominal 20 pN/nm) and modified Hertz fitting; no shared cell IDs with FRET were established. Phosphomimetic/dead RLC manipulations in S7 are not absolute phosphorylation stoichiometry. Supplement lists a PDF and 13 AVI files, not a raw paired table.
evidence_cards.pairing: Within-movie fluorescence/morphology potentially paired; FRET/AFM only condition-level comparison unless raw IDs establish otherwise.

evidence_cards.cell_or_specimen_context: Rat REF52 fibroblasts spread 3h on glass; human HUVECs on collagen. Culture 37°C; extraction/gelsolin at room temperature.
evidence_cards.observation_unit: Individual endogenous bipolar filament with two-size immunogold labeling; extracted-cell image.
evidence_cards.review_note: Double-labeled individual filaments were distinguished from parallel stacks. Approximately 25–40% of 348 filaments carried both IIA/IIB labels across the reported sample sets; incomplete labeling prevents reading single-label counts as pure-isoform fractions. Phosphorylated unfolded monomers were also imaged. Authors explicitly caution that differential extraction and antibody efficiencies prevent inferring their cellular abundance. Supports keeping composition, assembly state and phosphorylation as distinct quantities; no MCF7 mixture law follows.
evidence_cards.pairing: Filament morphology and dual-isoform labels paired on the same extracted object; not whole-cell protein inventory or live lifetime.

evidence_cards.cell_or_specimen_context: Purified recombinant human NM2A/B/C; overnight on ice, 150mM NaCl, with/without 1mM ATP. Analytical sedimentation 20°C.
evidence_cards.observation_unit: Protein concentration and sedimentation/light-scattering/EM species distribution, not cell object inventory.
evidence_cards.review_note: ATP and RLC phosphorylation change oligomer and filament distributions. At 400,000g, 20min, even half the monomer pellets; the authors correct both fractions accordingly. Ordinary detergent-soluble/insoluble fractions therefore cannot be equated with free whole minifilament objects. Multiple assays address matched biochemical conditions, not tracked individual molecules. The Fig.10 assembly route is a proposed interpretation, not a rate measurement. Public primary text inspected; API full-text retrieval failed, and no raw data repository was located.
evidence_cards.pairing: Matched in-vitro conditions across assays; no per-cell or per-object time-series pairing.

evidence_cards.cell_or_specimen_context: FLAG-RLC in human HEK293; functional experiments include CHO.K1 and A549, not MCF7.
evidence_cards.observation_unit: Immunoprecipitated expressed RLC phosphopeptides; separate interaction/functional assays.
evidence_cards.review_note: The approximately 70% pS19 result is from FLAG-RLC expressed at 10–20% of endogenous level, after 30min peroxovanadate (1µM) and calyculin A (10nM), not untreated endogenous heads. Immunoprecipitation does not establish the denominator of assembled force-capable heads. Fig.5 distinguishes free RLC and heavy-chain-bound RLC interactions. Key Resources lists no deposited data. Thus this numerical phospho signal cannot fill the model head-competence fraction.

evidence_cards.observation_unit: Intensity-based foci/minifilament estimate per planar ROI; separate spatiotemporal correlation readout.
evidence_cards.review_note: The 40±20 estimate remains explicit numerical support for 0.625/µm², with HeLa/context and focus-to-object projection caveats. It uses foci intensity and mean cortical intensity, not resolved whole-surface counting. The inspected instrument is confocal; saved SE337 shorthand says super-resolution. STICS decay combines contraction/motion and turnover; individual foci were too difficult to track accurately. Fitted model dissociation values are not measured kinetic labels. conditional_mappings.target_denominator: IIA share of all allocated A/B minifilament objects, including assembled and dormant objects; no IIC or mixed-object branch in the inspected split. It is generally not the initial assembled-object isoform share.

candidate_arithmetic.quantity: IIA share conditional on A/B peptide-abundance proxy, not object composition

conditions_before_mapping: Resolve peptide response calibration and SEM/SD discrepancy from original replicate data.
PI must define A/B-only projection, including treatment of IIC and the unmeasured assembled fractions by isoform.
Per-object mapping additionally requires comparable molecules per object and an explicit treatment of mixed filaments.
Establish transfer from adherent confluent MCF7/ZA context to rounded suspended MCF7.
not_allowed: Do not enter 0.814 as a parameter or training label.
Do not propagate reported component errors independently; composition shares and repeated preparations are dependent.
Do not infer entire-cell ZA allocation from localization.
conditional_mappings.initial_state_distinction: NA=round(fA*N_allocated); NA_alive=min(NA,N_assembled); NB_alive=max(0,N_assembled-NA) from intersecting the isoform and alive prefixes. No empirical mapping is inferred.

conditional_mappings.expression: For an illustrative closed, homogeneous two-state population with constant rates: stationary f_assembled = k_a/(k_a+k_d); relaxation lambda = k_a+k_d; k_a=f_assembled*lambda; k_d=(1-f_assembled)*lambda.
conditional_mappings.required_observations: Same-context assembled/total object inventory plus an independently identifiable object-state relaxation or tracked birth/death exposure.
conditional_mappings.identifiability: A stationary assembled fraction identifies a ratio, not both rates. Protein FRAP, FRET dwell, STICS decorrelation, cluster threshold crossing and whole-object destruction have different observation operators.
assumptions: A fixed, tracked population with only the two modeled object states; no unmodeled entry, exit, merge or split.
Constant homogeneous positive transition rates in a matched condition and a stationary fraction measurement.
The relaxation observable identifies object-state relaxation, with detection, bleaching, censoring and motion distinguished.
This algebra is not a demonstration that a recorded native run or any cited fluorescence assay meets these assumptions.

conditional_mappings.target_denominator: Within each isoform, all allocated head owner IDs, including dormant objects: the fraction selected to own a crossbridge relation after isoform-specific integer rounding. Not the measured fraction of initially active, bound or force-producing heads.
conditional_mappings.required_observations: Calibrated phosphosite occupancy with explicit free/bound RLC denominator, plus independently validated mapping to head competence for isoform, assembly, ATP/load and cell state.
conditional_mappings.identifiability: Phospho-antibody intensity, phosphopeptide share, actin proximity, ATPase activity, duty occupancy and force-capable head fraction are separate observables.

conditional_mappings.expression: For a declared ROI projection, structural head count = object count * heads per object; active-force readout additionally depends on competence, binding occupancy, geometry and load.
conditional_mappings.identifiability: A single aggregate count-product or force projection generally leaves these factors unresolved; no full-model structural-identifiability result is asserted. Complementary calibrated measurements and an explicit observation operator are required.
conditional_mappings.target_area_definition: Initially assembled object density uses smooth mid-shell reference area 4*pi*r_shell^2; not membrane.area0, wrinkled area, planar optical ROI area or cortex volume.
